substitutes: A recycled cereal box or large envelope for the capsule
title: The Puppy Time Capsule
clue: A box that sleeps for a while, holding the exact moment your puppy is in right now, chosen partly by their nose.
reveal: Puppies change quickly, and the small things you adore this week are the ones you will forget. Lay out a little sniff table of safe things, see which your puppy picks first, play the game they choose, and seal it all into a capsule to open later. The capsule even carries the smell of today.
objective: Fill and seal a capsule with your puppy's current favorites, with a nose-chosen cover item and a scale photo to compare against later.
instructions: Find a shoebox or large envelope, plus paper, a pen, a small paper bag and your phone. Pick a relaxed moment when your puppy is awake and settled. This all happens indoors, at home.

Lay a sniff table on a clean floor: a patch of their blanket, one favorite toy, a hand-sized piece of old T-shirt that smells like you, and a plain card. Sit back and let your puppy nose around in whatever order they like. Note which item they sniff first and longest, and lift anything they start to chew. That item is the Chosen One.

Offer two toys and let your puppy pick the one to play with. Play whichever they choose, in whatever way they like, for as long as they like. Do not chase them, do not take the toy away; if they leave, the game is over and that counts.
Fill in the capsule card: today's date, your puppy's name, three favorites (a toy, a spot, a game), their funniest habit, the Chosen One and a few words on what an ordinary day feels like together.
Take a 'for scale' photo: your puppy resting or sniffing next to a familiar object such as a shoe, a mug or a favorite toy. Do not pose them; take several and keep the natural one.

Seal a swatch of their blanket in the small paper bag: the smell of today. Add the capsule card, a note to your future selves about what you hope you will still be doing together and one flat keepsake that is not chewable, such as a printed photo. Skip anything small or edible.

Close the lid or flap and set the sealed capsule on the floor for a one-minute sniff if your puppy is curious, their first hello to the future. Then lift it away before anything is chewed, write the 'open on' date on the lid or flap and store it somewhere your puppy cannot reach.
twist: Your puppy helps pack it: the item their nose picks first goes on top as the Chosen One, and the smell of today is sealed in with it.
variations: Five-minute version: sniff table and photo only, no game.
Seated version: do the card and the photo from the sofa while your puppy naps beside you.
Digital version: keep the card and photo in a folder on your phone and set a reminder for a date you choose.
No opening date: seal it with 'open when it feels right' on the lid.
completion: The capsule is filled, sealed, labeled and stored out of reach. A puppy who sniffs once and naps still completes it.
photoIdea: A relaxed shot beside a familiar object for scale, in natural light, with no posing. This becomes the 'then' photo.
memoryPrompt: Which item did your puppy sniff first, and what do you most want to remember about this week?
safety: Keep the capsule contents out of reach and use only toys in good shape; paper and cloth are not for chewing.
Play only as long as your puppy enjoys it, and ask your vet what play suits their age and when public places are fine.
